agent_note: Dominant stance is third-person present-tense narration of a named character (Billy), including present-tense thought reports. The past minority is not noise: q05618 and q05621 are first-person past recollection in a plainer, misspelled-register voice ('2 kinds of people', 'By then I was a teenager'), and q05617/q05632 share that first-person voice - an identifiable embedded first-person memoir strand written by the character, matching the Cloud Cuckoo Land embedded-strand precedent. Quotation marks survive in this book (q05627, q05647), so mark-majority was the primary dialogue signal; for q05620, q05649, q05652 and q05658 marks were absent and direct address, toast formula, speaker labels and register were used instead, as recorded per quote. Gnomic was applied only to present-tense material generalizing beyond the story world - real-world expository facts (q05645, q05650) and aphorisms - never to past-tense summary. Borderline: q05632 mixes a present generalization with a past story-world reference ('the kind we gave him'); if read as event/past it would double the past count.
